summary: This candidate chunk contains only Oklo, which is relevant to the Energy and Power Chain theme through the speculative advanced-nuclear/firm-power lane, but it ranks as a low-priority Serenity research candidate versus concrete grid-equipment, transformer, switchgear, electrical-construction, fuel-cycle, and operating-generation bottlenecks. The main issue is not thematic relevance; it is evidence quality and public-market chokepoint proof. Oklo may benefit from AI/data-center interest in clean firm power, but the current thesis depends on NRC licensing, fuel availability, project financing, customer contract enforceability, and construction execution that remain to be verified.
